excerpt: Figure 7 reports fluorescence kinetics data of the two pairs of dual-rail outputs. The arrays for the DNA circuit were plotted using the output values at 24 h from the data, and the ideal logic circuit behaviour corresponds to a black dog image for R1241, an inverted image for R1240, and mirror images for R1101 and R1100.
overview: This figure-level evidence connects molecular fluorescence measurements to the intended cellular automata visualization. It matters because the paper’s design and tuning pipeline culminates in the full rule 110-124 circuit, not only isolated gates or sub-circuits. The comparison is qualitative and visual, so it supports successful pattern-level computation rather than exact analog agreement at every time point.
title: Full Circuit 24-Hour Output
